tags.name: TelemetryService
tags.description:
The protocol Telemetry Agents use to publish fleet observations to Franz.
Agent-facing; not exposed through the REST gateway.

v1AccessPolicy.description:
One access-policy document per channel. Evaluation for a (client, action):
take the statements whose principal matches the client and whose permissions
include the action; if any is EFFECT_DENY the action is denied; otherwise if
any is EFFECT_ALLOW it is allowed; otherwise denied (zero trust).

permissions.description: One or more of PERMISSION_READ / PERMISSION_WRITE. Must be non-empty.

type.description: Organisational filter only; does not change how the agent connects.

labels.description:
Arbitrary metadata labels — for information and as an extension point
(owner, team, environment, future scoping rules, …).

status.description:
Lifecycle state. Franz sets ACTIVE at registration; PAUSED/DELETED are
reached through PauseAgent / ResumeAgent / DeleteAgent. Liveness/health
(last contact, connected vs stale) is not modelled yet — see 003.9.

provisioningLabels.description:
Advisory schema: the franz.provisioning/* labels this agent's recipes
understand, with allowed values and defaults. Franz stores and serves it
for the console to render resource forms; it never validates another
resource's labels against it. See 003.9.

v1Agent.description:
An agent is a program registered with Franz that connects to the fleet API
over gRPC, pulls work, and reports results. Franz never calls an agent.

v1AgentStatus.description:
- AGENT_STATUS_ACTIVE: Registered and eligible to receive work.
 - AGENT_STATUS_PAUSED: Registered but Franz hands it no work.
 - AGENT_STATUS_DELETED: Soft-deleted. Terminal; the record is retained for audit.

v1AgentType.description:
- AGENT_TYPE_CLUSTER_PROVIDER: Deploys and maintains a substrate (Kafka cluster, RabbitMQ, ...).
 - AGENT_TYPE_RESOURCE_PROVIDER: Realises individual resources (Kafka topics, queues). Gregor Samsa is one.
 - AGENT_TYPE_TELEMETRY_AGENT: Publishes indicator and consumer-group telemetry. Odradek is one.

name.description:
Unique name, provided at creation. Also the base name Franz uses to
generate Kafka topic names.

channelPartitions.description:
Shard count: Franz splits the channel into this many Kafka Topics, named
"<name>-<index>" (index 0..channel_partitions-1). Changing it is a staged
re-shard operation (003.4 / 003.11), not a plain field write.

labels.description: Arbitrary metadata labels for this channel.

accessPolicy.description:
Who may use this channel. One document, zero trust: a client with no
matching statement has no access.

v1AsyncChannel.description:
An Async Channel is the customer-facing boundary of asynchronous
communication. Creating one causes Franz to generate one or more linked
Kafka Topics (see kafka.proto). Formerly "Topic Definition".

matchedBy.description: Human-readable note on which statement matched.

v1ChannelClientAccess.description: The permission a specific client has on a channel, after evaluating the policy.

v1ChannelState.description:
- CHANNEL_STATE_ACTIVE: Franz maintains the channel and its shards automatically.
 - CHANNEL_STATE_PAUSED: Recorded, but Franz has stopped reconciling the channel's shards.
 - CHANNEL_STATE_DELETED: Soft-deleted; agents remove the real-world resources.

name.description: Globally unique, provided at registration. Also the default consumer-group prefix.

labels.description: At least org.com/owner. Channel access policies match against these.

v1Client.description:
A fleet-wide identity that reads from or writes to Async Channels through the
Franz SDK. A client has no Read/Write role of its own; every permission comes
from the access policy of the channel it connects to.

v1ClientChannelAccess.description:
A channel this client may use, and the permission granted. Derived from
every channel access policy whose statements match the client.

v1ClusterProviderEvent.description: One provider status report, retained as history.

v1ClusterProviderPhase.description:
What a Cluster Provider agent reports about a cluster it provisions.
This is agent-observed reality — distinct from KafkaClusterState (operator
intent). See 004-local-kafka-docker-agent.

v1ClusterProviderStatus.description:
Current provider-reported status for a cluster: the latest
cluster_provider_event. See 004-local-kafka-docker-agent.

v1ConnectionString.description:
A way to reach a cluster's brokers. Today only PLAINTEXT is supported; the
message exists so authenticated connection types can be added later.

token.description:
Bearer token the agent presents to authenticate (gRPC `authorization`
metadata). Returned once, on creation; Franz stores only its hash.
See 004-local-kafka-docker-agent.

v1CreateKafkaClusterRequest.description:
Only the client-settable fields of a KafkaCluster. Franz assigns the FRN and
the timestamps.

indicator.description:
The policy definition to evaluate against the latest samples. `weight` and
`enabled` do not affect a dry run and are omitted.

stalenessThreshold.description: Beyond this age the indicator is stale and policies reading it do not act.

v1Indicator.description:
An indicator that Telemetry Agents publish samples for and policies read.
Admin-created (CreateIndicator); a sample or policy for an unknown indicator
is rejected. See 003.14-telemetry-ingest.md.

v1IndicatorSampleView.description:
One stored indicator sample, returned by ListIndicatorSamples. The write-side
shape is telemetry.proto's IndicatorSample.

name.description: Control-plane identifier, provided at registration. Immutable.

connectionStrings.description:
How to reach the cluster's brokers. Repeated so additional connection
types (each with their own auth) can be added without a breaking change.

labels.description: Fleet context. Source of truth for placement matching.

clusterConfiguration.description:
Default Kafka configuration applied to topics on this cluster when nothing
more specific is declared (e.g. "default.replication.factor" -> "3").

clusterProviderAgent.description:
Optional name of the Cluster Provider agent that deploys and maintains this
cluster's substrate. Empty means the infrastructure is managed outside Franz.

state.description:
Lifecycle state. Franz sets ACTIVE at registration; PAUSED/DELETED are
reached through PauseKafkaCluster / ResumeKafkaCluster / DeleteKafkaCluster.
See 003.3-kafka-cluster.md for the state machine.

providerStatus.description:
What the Cluster Provider agent last reported (agent-observed reality,
distinct from `state`). Absent when there is no provider or no report yet.
Derived from the latest cluster_provider_event.

v1KafkaCluster.description:
A Kafka Cluster registration. Franz records where a cluster lives and its
fleet context; it never connects to the cluster. Real-world work is done by
the linked Cluster Provider agent (if any) and by Resource Provider agents.

v1KafkaClusterState.description:
- KAFKA_CLUSTER_STATE_ACTIVE: Registered and eligible for placement.
 - KAFKA_CLUSTER_STATE_PAUSED: Registered but excluded from new placement; existing topics are untouched.
 - KAFKA_CLUSTER_STATE_DELETED: Soft-deleted. Terminal; the record is retained for audit.

name.description: Franz-generated Kafka topic name (also the real name in the cluster).

kafkaCluster.description: Cluster this topic is placed on.

consumption.description:
Whether consumers may read this topic. When DISABLED the topic is drained:
producers stop writing to it and its traffic share drops to zero, while the
topic and its data are retained.

topicConfiguration.description:
Per-topic Kafka configuration (retention, cleanup policy, ...). Keys set here
win over the cluster configuration in the merge. Does NOT carry partition
count or replication factor — those are the dedicated fields below.

partitions.description: Desired Kafka partition count for the real topic. May only increase.

replicationFactor.description: Desired replication factor for the real topic.

trafficShare.description:
Intended share of channel traffic routed to this shard. Franz defaults to an
equal split across the shards whose consumption is ENABLED; a drained shard
is zero. Producers weight their routing by this value. It is an intention,
not a measurement.

generation.description:
Bumped whenever Franz changes this topic's desired state. Agents echo it
when reporting work so Franz can reject stale reports.

v1KafkaTopic.description:
A Kafka Topic is one generated topic of an Async Channel, placed on one
Kafka Cluster. It tracks reconciliation with the real topic. Formerly
"Topic Claim". Franz creates and deletes these; clients do not — every field
here is set by Franz. Consumption is changed through SetConsumption.

value.description:
Compared against the latest indicator sample. Encoding follows the
indicator's unit (e.g. "150Gi", "3", "90d").

selector.description: Label selector. Empty means every resource of the entity kind.

custom.description: true when the group name is not the default <client>.<topic> form.

lastSeenAt.description: Current view: most recent sighting. History view: the sighting's time.

v1ObservedConsumerGroup.description:
A consumer group observed for this client, reported by a Telemetry Agent.
Not registered in Franz. ListObservedConsumerGroups returns the current view
(one row per (group, topic), latest sighting); ListConsumerGroupObservations
returns the raw sightings within a time range. See 003.14-telemetry-ingest.md.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of items to return. The server may return fewer.

pageToken.description: Opaque token from a previous response's next_page_token. Empty for the first page.

v1PageRequest.description: Standard pagination request fields. Embed in every List request.

nextPageToken.description: Pass as PageRequest.page_token to fetch the next page. Empty when there are no more.

totalSize.description: Total number of items across all pages, when the server can compute it cheaply.

v1PageResponse.description: Standard pagination response fields. Embed in every List response.

v1Permission.description: A permission that a channel access policy statement grants to a client.

indicator.description: Indicator name published by a Telemetry Agent.

weight.description: Breaks ties when several policies act on the same resource. Higher wins.

v1Policy.description:
A governance policy watches one indicator and acts on the resources it
matches when a limit is crossed. Reactive only: actions change Franz's
declared state, which the normal reconciliation path realises.

v1PolicyAction.description: One automated change a policy made.

v1Principal.description:
A statement matches a client when its FRN matches client_frn (if set) OR its
labels satisfy the selector (if set); at least one must be set. Both
client_frn and the label-selector values accept `*` as a wildcard.

key.description:
Reserved-label key, e.g. "franz.provisioning/kafka-image". Must be
franz.-prefixed.

allowedValues.description: Allowed values; empty means free text.

defaultValue.description:
Pre-filled in the console form. When allowed_values is set, must be one of
them.

required.description: The console requires a value; Franz does not enforce it.

v1ProvisioningLabelSpec.description:
ProvisioningLabelSpec describes one franz.provisioning/* label an agent's
recipe reads. Advisory — a console UX aid only (003.9, ADR-API-008).

token.description: The new bearer token. The previous token is invalidated immediately.

v1TrafficShare.description: A proportion of channel traffic, e.g. value 45, unit "percent".
